usedFor: DeskTime tracks team time, and “Create Task” adds work to it when another app signals something.

bestTemplate.name: “New Clock In” in Jibble, then “Create Task” in DeskTime
bestTemplate.why: A clock in shows someone starting, so a task can already be waiting for them.

watchOut: Each connected event runs “Create Task” once, so test one before a busy trigger fires it often.
